name: pact-protocol-site
description: Static site build for the PACT specification.

scripts.serve: node --run build && node -e "import('node:http').then(async({default:h})=>{const {readFile}=await import('node:fs/promises');const {extname,join,normalize}=await import('node:path');const T={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript','.json':'application/json','.svg':'image/svg+xml'};h.createServer(async(q,s)=>{let p=normalize(decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]));if(p.endsWith('/'))p+='index.html';try{const b=await readFile(join('dist',p));s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':T[extname(p)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(b)}catch{s.writeHead(404);s.end('not found')}}).listen(4173,()=>console.log('http://localhost:4173/'))})"
